🚦 TRAFFIC ADVISORY – JPMC RUN 2026

A running event will be conducted in the IT corridor area of Cyberabad, covering roads around Sattva Knowledge City and nearby tech zones.

 Date: Sunday, 1 March 2026
⏰ Time: 06:30 AM to 08:00 AM
🏃 Distances: 5K & 10K Runs
👥 Participants: Approx. 1200

📍 Route Coverage:
Gate No.5 – Sattva Knowledge City → RMZ Junction → Qualcomm Dead End → Thangedu Restaurant → Dallas Center Road → T-Hub → C-Gate → Gate No.8 → Return to Gate No.5

⚠ Advisory for Commuters:
• Expect temporary road diversions in the event zone
• Plan alternate routes in advance
• Follow volunteers and event signage
• Drive slowly and remain alert
• Prioritize safety for all road users

Your cooperation ensures smooth traffic movement and a safe event for all.

Roads Shared. Safety First.
